# Abstract

Upon discovering the universe's physical invariant dx₄/dt = ic, I saw that the entirety of mathematical physics could be recovered from its rich physical, dynamic, geometric structure [1, 3, 4, 22, 26, 38, 71], as general relativity, quantum mechanics, thermodynamics, and the Conservation Laws all naturally descend from dx₄/dt = ic along two independent channels — an algebraic channel and a geometric channel. The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic states that the fourth dimension is expanding as a spherically-symmetric wavefront at the velocity of light. And remarkably, the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic operates through two distinct channels — the **McGucken Duality** — that are two different *kinds* of mathematical object: **The dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel exalts physical geometry — with the McGucken Sphere as the physical, geometric primitive expanding at +ic from every event as a spherically-symmetric wavefront. The dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is mathematical — algebraic structures existing outside of physical spacetime, with the operator-algebra and symmetry-analytic apparatus of Noether, Heisenberg, Born, Jordan, Stone, von Neumann, Wigner, Wightman, and Haag–Kastler as the algebra.** The dual-channel architecture is therefore the geometry/algebra distinction of mathematics applied to foundational physics, with eighteen differential signatures distinguishing the two channels (§IX.30.A of the present paper, established through Wigner's antiunitary time-reversal operator and the Bisognano–Wichmann / Tomita–Takesaki modular theory). The keystone of the framework is the recognition that the dual-channel architecture is *the* fundamental distinction of mathematics — geometry versus algebra, Euclid 300 BCE versus Diophantus 250 CE — applied to foundational physics.

The dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel is the physical, geometric channel exalted by the physical reality of the McGucken Sphere, and the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is its mathematical descendant. The McGucken Sphere [23, 30, 31, 41, 62, 78] arises naturally from the McGucken Principle that the fourth dimension is expanding at the velocity of light in a spherically-symmetric manner from every event of spacetime, and the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is the mathematical, algebraic shadow of the Sphere. Despite the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's physical primacy, the Algebraic Channel developed first based on early observational data. Historically speaking, the Algebraic Channel was built from two kinds of input — spectroscopic data (Heisenberg 1925, Born–Jordan 1925, and Dirac 1925, working from atomic emission spectra and the Ritz combination principle) and pure mathematical structure (Noether 1918 from Lie-group invariance of variational problems, Stone 1932 from one-parameter unitary groups, von Neumann 1932 from Hilbert-space theory, Wigner 1939 from unitary irreducible representations of the Poincaré group, and Wightman 1956 from axiomatic-QFT foundations) — without ever invoking a McGucken Sphere, establishing the channel and all its derivations as independently constructible (Theorem IX.30.B.1). All of these constructions unknowingly rested atop the more foundational McGucken Sphere. Schrödinger 1926 came closest to invoking a McGucken Sphere: he derived the wave equation from de Broglie's matter-wave hypothesis using wave-in-physical-space reasoning, wanted to interpret $|\psi|^2$ as a physical charge distribution in space, and resisted the abstract operator formalism throughout his life — but the algebraic tradition prevailed through von Neumann's 1932 Hilbert-space formalization and the Copenhagen interpretation, and the physical wave Schrödinger sought remained unidentified as the McGucken Sphere expanding at every event. The Geometric Channel was built by McGucken from dx₄/dt = ic; no prior tradition constructed it because no prior tradition possessed the Principle of the fourth dimension physically expanding at the rate of c. Each channel is buildable from its own foundations without invoking the other — about the two constructions — but the historical labor was asymmetric: many hands built the algebraic shadow across three decades from empirical data; one hand built the geometric source from the McGucken Principle. But at the **physical** level, the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's content contains directional geometry that dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebraic apparatus cannot reach: algebra is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation that geometry carries as primitive content (Theorem IX.30.C.3). The two facts coexist because they answer different questions: *can each channel be built from its own foundations?* (yes, both can); *does one channel's content contain directional content that the other cannot reach?* (yes, the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's geometric directional content is inaccessible to the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebraic apparatus). What Heisenberg built in 1925 is the time-reversal-symmetric algebraic shadow of the principle dx₄/dt = +ic. The shadow is genuine and self-sufficient as a mathematical object; the principle is what the universe runs on.

Every theorem of general relativity and quantum mechanics admits two independent derivations from dx₄/dt = ic — one through the Algebraic Channel (operator algebras, Stone's theorem, Noether currents, Lovelock uniqueness), one through the Geometric Channel (the McGucken Sphere, Huygens propagation, Bekenstein–Hawking area law). The 47-theorem dual catalog of [3] enumerates them: 24 GR theorems (Einstein field equations, Schwarzschild solution, Mercury perihelion, gravitational waves at $c$ within $10^{-15}$, Bekenstein–Hawking entropy, Hawking temperature) and 23 QM theorems (canonical commutator, Schrödinger equation, Born rule, Heisenberg uncertainty, Dirac equation, Tsirelson bound $2\sqrt 2$, CHSH correlation, CPT), each with both derivations written out — 94 derivations in total. These 47 form the **Catalog of Symmetries** of time-symmetric content, reached through the Algebraic Channel by Theorem IX.30.B.1 (Stone's theorem, Noether, Lovelock, operator algebra) and through the Geometric Channel by Theorem IX.30.B.2 (McGucken Sphere expansion). Their Wimsatt-1981 robustness supplies the Bayesian likelihood ratio $\gtrsim 10^{141}$ of Theorem IX.26.11 of [3]. The McGucken Principle is itself derivable through both channels, satisfying the shared-derivation property that organizes the 47 downstream catalog items (§IX.30.C.23 below: the Principle as its own theorem). The Geometric derivation (Theorem IX.30.C.23.1) proceeds via a six-step light-sphere argument: (i) empirical invariance of $c$ fixes the four-velocity magnitude $u^\mu u_\mu = -c^2$; (ii) the Pythagorean partition gives $d\tau/dt = \sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}$; (iii) photons at $v = c$ have $d\tau/dt = 0$ and are stationary in $x_4$; (iv) photons trace the future null hypersurface $\Sigma^+(p)$, whose $t$-slices are the McGucken Spheres $\Sigma_M^+(p, t)$; (v) each Sphere grows radially at rate $c$; (vi) the coordinate-time-limit of the source-to-reception $x_4$-difference yields $dx_4/dt = +ic$, with the $+ic$ sign forced by future-directedness of wavefront propagation. The Algebraic derivation (Theorem IX.30.C.23.2) proceeds in one line: differentiating Minkowski's 1908 identity $x_4 = ict$ with respect to $t$ gives $dx_4/dt = ic$. Theorem IX.30.C.23.3 establishes derivational disjointness — the two derivations share only the Minkowski manifold and the conclusion — and Corollary IX.30.C.23.2 establishes that both derivations were independently available from Minkowski 1908 forward, so the dual-channel architecture is not merely a consequence of the Principle but the epistemic condition under which the Principle is derivable. Alongside the 47, a separate **Catalog of Asymmetries** of seventeen time-asymmetric items sits in the Geometric Channel alone (full enumeration at §IX.30.C.2): the +ic orientation itself, the strict Second Law $dS/dt > 0$, the five-or-six aligned arrows of time, the radiative arrow's preference for retarded over advanced Green's function, the Wick-rotation sign $t \to -i\tau$, the cosmological expansion direction $H_0 > 0$, the McGucken-Sphere recursion direction, the causal cone orientation, decoherence monotonicity, structure formation, black hole area growth $dA/dt \geq 0$, Hawking radiation outgoing-flux direction, CMB redshift direction, the matter-dominance baryogenesis direction, and Penrose's Weyl curvature arrow. Each is time-asymmetric and has no Algebraic Channel derivation, because algebra is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation that geometry carries as content. The Loschmidt no-go theorem (Theorem IX.30.C.2.2) makes this explicit: under $dx_4/dt = +ic$ with the McGucken-Sphere Compton-coupling Brownian mechanism of [4], no entropy-decreasing macroscopic trajectory exists. The 150-year Loschmidt–Boltzmann standoff dissolves — both were right within their respective channels. Loschmidt operated on the Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebra; Boltzmann operated on what is, in modern hindsight, the Geometric Channel's +ic-oriented content. The Past Hypothesis dissolves as Corollary IX.30.C.2.3: Penrose's $10^{-10^{123}}$ improbability is computed under the wrong prior, since the +ic Sphere origin at $t = t_p^+$ is the geometrically necessary lowest-entropy moment, not a fine-tuning.

The thirty-year Black Hole War was operating on the symmetric algebraic shadow of the actual physics, missing the +ic-oriented the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel content that carries the operational information destruction. Fifty years of orthodox unification work has been computing in the algebraic shadow. The geometric source content is not recoverable from the algebraic shadow. That is why no observable physics has emerged.

Remarkably beautiful facets of dx₄/dt = ic soon emerged. The wide-ranging derivational power of the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic quickly becomes apparent — general relativity, quantum mechanics, and thermodynamics descend as independent theorem chains, with the 47-theorem architecture of [3] (24 GR theorems and 23 QM theorems, 94 total derivations across both channels) catalogued in full and the thermodynamic chain of [4] supplying the strict Second Law $dS/dt > 0$ as a theorem of the +ic orientation of dx₄/dt = ic; the present paper develops the dual-channel account of this corpus, with the introductory cascade below supplying the reader's first taste of the framework's reach. **The Lorentzian metric drops out in two lines**: $dx_{4} = ic\,dt$ gives $dx_{4}^{2} = -c^{2}\,dt^{2}$, so the squared interval becomes $ds^{2} = dx_{1}^{2} + dx_{2}^{2} + dx_{3}^{2} + dx_{4}^{2} = dx_{1}^{2} + dx_{2}^{2} + dx_{3}^{2} - c^{2}\,dt^{2}$. # Preface: The McGucken Duality dx₄/dt = ic. The Physics, The Mathematics, The History

*(A standalone preface, written for the reader who wants the full articulation of the McGucken Duality before entering the body of the paper. The preface treats the Duality at three layers, physical, mathematical, and historical, each. The reader who wants only the technical content of the paper may skip the preface and proceed directly to §I. Introduction; the preface is for the reader who wants to understand what the McGucken Duality is, at the level, before the technical articulation begins.)*

The McGucken Duality is contemporary foundational physics. It is simultaneously about how the universe operates, a algebraic structureM that organizes the entire content of foundational physics into a coherent architecture, and a historical position that resolves a 250-year pattern of fragmentary articulations across the history of foundational physics. This preface articulates the Duality at all three layers, each at the rigor of a theorem.

## P.1 Physically: What the McGucken Duality IS

The McGucken Duality is that x₄'s active expansion at velocity c — read as a spherically symmetric wavefront from every spacetime event — admits two distinct physical readings simultaneously, with both readings being components of the same physical reality.

The physics of the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic, articulated at §I.1 below, is that the fourth dimension expands as a spherically symmetric wavefront at velocity c, with the wavefront carrying wavelength λ, frequency ν, phase φ, and therefore action S accumulating per cycle of the advance. The wavefront at every event is a single physical object — one geometric primitive, one. But that single object has two distinct sets of properties that physics has been articulating separately for 120 years through machinery that did not recognize the common source.

### P.1.1 The wavefront's geometric-propagation: the McGucken dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel

The wavefront has a definite spatial shape at every retarded time — the McGucken Sphere $\Sigma_M^+(p, t-t_p) = \{(\mathbf x, t) \in \mathcal M_G : |\mathbf x - \mathbf x_p| = c(t - t_p)\}$ at every event $p$, and the spatial shape evolves via spherical-symmetric expansion at velocity c with full $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ symmetry on the spatial three-slice. This Sphere expansion is the physics of Huygens' 1690 Principle: the wavefront propagates as iterated secondary wavelets, with each point on the Sphere serving as the source of a secondary wavelet whose envelope reconstructs the next instant of the wavefront. The Sphere expansion is also the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy formula $S_{BH} = k_B A/(4\ell_P^2)$: the entropy of a horizon Sphere is the count of wavefront modes per Planck cell on the Sphere surface, with $\ell_P^2$ as the per-mode area quantum and $A/(4\ell_P^2)$ as the dimensionless mode-count. The strict Second Law $dS/dt = (3/2)k_B/t > 0$ for massive-particle ensembles, with the parallel form $dS/dt = 2k_B/(t - t_0) > 0$ for photon ensembles on the McGucken Sphere, is the Sphere's monotonic radial expansion at +ic — the Sphere expands outward, never inward; the entropy increases, never decreases. The radiative arrow is the +ic-oriented retarded Green's function being preferred over the −ic-oriented advanced Green's function as the physical-propagation kernel of the wave equation. The cosmological expansion at the universe scale, with the CMB-frame as the global x₄-expansion frame (configuration 4 of the four-fold ontology of §I.2), is the universe-scale Sphere expansion at every event. The Unruh temperature $T_U = \hbar a/(2\pi c k_B)$ on a local Rindler horizon and the Clausius relation $\delta Q = T\,dS$ on a horizon Sphere are the Sphere's thermodynamic behavior at the gravitational tier. The Friedmann equations $H^2 = (8\pi G/3)\rho + \Lambda c^2/3$ and $\ddot a/a = -(4\pi G/3)(\rho + 3p/c^2) + \Lambda c^2/3$ are the cosmological-scale Sphere expansion under the FLRW metric. All of these structures are **The McGucken dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel** — the wavefront's geometric-propagation read through Riemannian / Lorentzian geometry, Huygens construction, and horizon thermodynamics.

### P.1.2 The wavefront's algebraic-spectral content: the McGucken dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel

The wavefront has a definite phase that advances at the rate $\omega = c/\lambda$, and the phase advance accumulates an action quantum ℏ per cycle. This action-quantum accumulation is the physics of the Stone-theorem unitary group $U(t) = \exp(-i\hat H t/\hbar)$ — the wavefront's phase advance, read through the Hilbert-space machinery, IS the unitary evolution of quantum mechanics. The canonical commutator $[\hat q, \hat p] = i\hbar$ is the wavefront's per-tick action quantum read through the position-momentum operator algebra. The Wigner classification of mass and spin eigenvalues on the mass-shell $P^{\mu} P_{\mu} = -m^2 c^2$ is the wavefront's discrete-spectrum content read through the irreducible-representation theory of the Poincaré group $\mathrm{ISO}(1,3) = \mathbb R^{1,3} \rtimes \mathrm{SO}^+(1,3)$. The CPT theorem is the wavefront's full 4D coordinate-reversal symmetry. The Lorentz invariance of c (bound at $|\Delta c/c| \lesssim 10^{-20}$ by GRB 090510 [Vasileiou 2013]) is the wavefront's frame-invariant advance rate. The Standard Model gauge groups $U(1) \times SU(2)_L \times SU(3)_c$ are the Clifford-algebraic extension of the wavefront's imaginary perpendicularity marker $i$ in dx₄/dt = ic, embedded in the Clifford algebra $C\ell(1,3)$ with four gamma matrices $\gamma^{\mu}$ satisfying $\{\gamma^{\mu}, \gamma^{\nu}\} = 2\eta^{\mu\nu}$. The Heisenberg uncertainty principle $\sigma_q \sigma_p \geq \hbar/2$ is the numbers of the wavefront's substrate-tick discreteness at the position-momentum level. The Stone-von Neumann uniqueness theorem is the categoricity statement that the wavefront's phase-advance content has a unique representation up to unitary equivalence. All of these structures are **The McGucken dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel** — the wavefront's algebraic-spectral content read through operator algebras and symmetry groups.

### P.1.3 the unifying claim: the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel is geometry; the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is algebra; algebra is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation that geometry carries as primitive content

**The two channels do not stand in a sibling relation. They stand in a geometry/algebra relation: the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel is geometry — real shapes in real spacetime, with the McGucken Sphere as the geometric primitive expanding at +ic from every event; the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is algebra — symbolic structures that do not live in spacetime, with the operator-algebra and symmetry-analytic apparatus of Noether, Heisenberg, Born, Jordan, Stone, von Neumann, Wigner, Wightman, and Haag–Kastler as the algebra.** This is the keystone of the framework, established at §IX.30 of the present paper through Wigner's antiunitary time-reversal operator $T$ acting on the McGucken-framework (Definition IX.30.1). Under $T$, every dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel object listed in §P.1.2 is preserved (modulo conventions on parameter direction that are not part of the algebra) — the Lorentzian metric, the Lorentz group, the canonical commutator $[\hat q, \hat p] = i\hbar$, Stone's unitary one-parameter group $U(t) = \exp(-i\hat H t/\hbar)$, the McGucken Lagrangian, the Noether currents, the CPT operator are all time-symmetric (Remark IX.30.A.4.4). Under $T$, every asymmetric the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel object listed in §P.1.1 is sent to its sign-reversed counterpart — the future-directed McGucken Sphere $\Sigma_M^+(p)$ goes to the past-directed $\Sigma_M^-(p)$, the strict Second Law $dS/dt > 0$ flips to $dS/dt < 0$, the retarded Green's function goes to the advanced, the Wick rotation $t \to -i\tau$ flips sign, the cosmological-expansion direction flips, the McGucken-Sphere recursion direction flips. The content asymmetry: the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebraic apparatus is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation and cannot carry it. The dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's geometric primitives carry the +ic orientation as features. The dual-channel architecture has its asymmetric content (the seventeen mono-channel items of §IX.30.C.2) because geometry has directional content as a mathematical feature and algebra does not.

The relation between physical reality and orthodox quantum mechanics is therefore: physical reality is the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's geometry; orthodox quantum mechanics is the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebraic encoding of that's measurement statistics. What Heisenberg constructed in 1925 — and what Born, Jordan, Dirac, Stone, von Neumann, Wigner, and Wightman built after him — is the time-reversal-symmetric algebraic shadow of the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = +ic. The shadow is a genuine mathematical object: internally consistent, independently constructible, empirically anchored to atomic spectra and the electron $g-2$ and every other time-symmetric measurement. **But it is a shadow.** The full physics — the universe with its +ic orientation, its arrow of time, its cosmological expansion, its matter dominance — lives in the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel, where the principle dx₄/dt = +ic resides. **The historical-constructive fact of the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's independent buildability** (Theorem IX.30.B.1: Heisenberg 1925 through Wightman 1956 built the algebraic apparatus from spectroscopic data and algebraic axioms without invoking a McGucken Sphere) **coexists with the physical- of the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's content-primacy** (Theorem IX.30.C.3: the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's content carries directional geometry that dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebraic apparatus cannot reach). Both statements are true at once because they answer different questions, and the framework's claim on the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's status is the *physical* claim that the +ic-oriented McGucken Sphere expansion at every event is the universe, not the *constructive* claim that dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel cannot be built without the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel.

**The 47-theorem dual catalog of [3] is the Catalog of Symmetries of time-symmetric content** — the 47 theorems where the two channels agree because both halves of mathematics (geometric and algebraic) converge on the same physical statement, reachable both from the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebraic structureG (Theorem IX.30.B.1's the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel constructive route) and from the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's algebraic structureI (Theorem IX.30.B.2's the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel constructive route). Each of these theorems is time-symmetric (Lorentz invariance of c, canonical commutator, Schrödinger equation, Einstein field equations, Born rule, Tsirelson bound, CPT theorem, Bekenstein–Hawking entropy with the factor 1/4, Hawking temperature, and 37 more); each admits both a dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel derivation through algebraic structureG and a dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel derivation through algebraic structureI; the two derivations share no intermediate machinery (Definition IX.26.2's Dual-Channel Disjointness Predicate), and the Wimsatt-1981 overdetermination of the joint convergence supplies the Bayesian likelihood ratio $\gtrsim 10^{141}$ of Theorem IX.26.11. The dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's apparatus is constructively independent of the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel; the 47-theorem dual catalog records this independence.

**Seventeen further items constitute the Catalog of Asymmetries of time-asymmetric content** carried by the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel alone — items that are inaccessible to the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebraic apparatus because algebra is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation that geometry carries (full enumeration at §IX.30.C.2). The +ic orientation itself, the strict Second Law $dS/dt > 0$, the radiative arrow's preference for retarded over advanced Green's function, the Wick-rotation sign $t \to -i\tau$, the causal-cone orientation, the McGucken-Sphere recursion direction, cosmological structure formation, black hole area growth $dA/dt \geq 0$, Hawking radiation outgoing-flux direction, the cosmological-expansion direction $H_0 > 0$, the CMB redshift direction, the matter-antimatter asymmetry direction, Penrose's Weyl curvature arrow — each is the +ic orientation manifesting in a different physical context. The Loschmidt no-go theorem (Theorem IX.30.C.2.2) is now stated explicitly: under dx₄/dt = +ic with the McGucken-Sphere Compton-coupling Brownian mechanism of [4], no entropy-decreasing macroscopic trajectory exists. The 150-year Loschmidt–Boltzmann standoff is dissolved : both were right within their respective channels, with Loschmidt's reversibility objection applying entirely to the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebra (which cannot derive strict monotonicity, exactly as Loschmidt argued) and Boltzmann's H-theorem applying (in modern hindsight) to the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's +ic-oriented geometry (which carries the monotonicity by the +ic orientation of the active expansion). There was never an actual conflict — the unitary evolution (the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel) and the monotonic entropy increase (the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel) hold simultaneously at every instant, as two channels of the one principle.

The Past Hypothesis dissolves as Corollary IX.30.4.3. Penrose's $10^{-10^{123}}$ improbability of the universe's low-entropy initial state [Penrose 1989, 2010] is computed under the prior that the initial macrostate is unconstrained. The McGucken framework supplies the natural constrained prior: at the McGucken Sphere's origin $t = t_p^+$ from any source event, the Sphere has radius $R = 0$, area $4\pi R^2 = 0$, and entropy $S \to -\infty$ as $t \to t_p^+$. The origin of the active expansion at every event is the geometrically necessary lowest-entropy moment; no fine-tuning is required. Penrose's number measures an improbability under the wrong prior — the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric prior with no preferred low-entropy state — rather than under the correct dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel prior with the +ic origin as the natural low-entropy point.

The five (or six) aligned arrows of time all project one +ic orientation. The conventionally-identified arrows of time — thermodynamic, radiative, cosmological, quantum-mechanical, psychological, plus Penrose's Weyl curvature arrow — are all projections of the single +ic orientation (Corollary IX.30.4.4). The dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebra is incapable of producing any of them because the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is time-symmetric. Their alignment — all five (or six) arrows pointing the same direction — is one fact (+ic commitment) read through five-or-six different physical contexts. The standard topic in foundations of physics — "the puzzle of why the arrows of time align" [Albert 2000, Loewer 2007] — dissolves in the McGucken framework: they align because they are projections of one orientation, not independently-pointed arrows that happen to coordinate.

Where the framework speaks of the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel as the channel of *what is preserved* and the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel as the channel of *what flows*, the word "preserved" carries a precise technical sense: time-symmetry under Wigner's antiunitary time-reversal, i.e., the claim sits in the fixed-point set of the time-reversal action. This is distinct from conservation in the sense of obeying a conservation law. The conservation laws of physics — energy, momentum, total probability $\int|\psi|^2 = 1$, the Noether currents associated with continuous symmetries — hold *within* the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's channel contentB at every event: the Sphere expands at +ic *and* the four-velocity normalization $u^\mu u_\mu = -c^2$ holds; entropy increases monotonically *and* energy is conserved; horizon area grows *and* the Bondi mass plus radiated energy is conserved; the universe expands at $H_0 > 0$ *and* the energy-momentum tensor satisfies the Bianchi identity. The conservation laws sit in the time-symmetric content shared between the channels (the 47-theorem dual catalog). The +ic-oriented flow direction is what distinguishes the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel from the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebra; it is the time-asymmetric geometry with no dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel counterpart. The dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel contains everything the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel contains, plus the +ic-oriented directional geometry that algebra is sign-symmetric on. The flow respects the conservation laws because the conservation laws live in the time-symmetric content that dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel carries along with the +ic orientation.

### P.1.4 The three diagnoses

The two channels admit three complementary diagnoses, each classifying content of the Duality:

**(P.1.4.A) The position-of-i diagnosis (§IX.13.14).** the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's objects have $i$ interior to algebraic structures ($U(t) = \exp(-i\hat H t/\hbar)$ with $i$ interior to the exponential; $[\hat q, \hat p] = i\hbar$ with $i$ interior to the commutator algebra; $\gamma^{\mu}$ matrices via $\{\gamma^{\mu}, \gamma^{\nu}\} = 2\eta^{\mu\nu}$ with $i$ interior to the Clifford-algebraic structure; the eikonal phase weight $e^{iS/\hbar}$ with $i$ interior to the algebraic-action expression; the Berry phase $e^{i\oint A}$ with $i$ interior to the geometric-phase loop integral). **(P.1.4.B) The symmetry/asymmetry diagnosis (§IX.13.14.bis, refined by §IX.30 dual-channel architecture).** the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is symmetry-rich: every object of the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is a symmetry statement, with the Poincaré group $\mathrm{ISO}(1,3)$, Stone's unitary group, the Wigner classification, Stone-von Neumann uniqueness, Noether's theorem, gauge invariance, the CPT theorem, and the Lorentz invariance of c all articulating what is preserved under group actions. The only the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel asymmetry is the indefinite Lorentzian signature $(-,+,+,+)$, a static algebraic feature of the metric tensor without dynamics. The dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel is asymmetry-rich with a spherically symmetric source: the spatial axis is fully $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-symmetric under rotations of the McGucken Sphere about the source event, while the temporal axis is chirally asymmetric under the +ic orientation (the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic is signed, not $\pm ic$). The word "preserved" here means *time-symmetric*, not *conserved* in the sense of obeying a conservation law: the conservation laws of physics (energy, momentum, total probability, Noether currents) hold within the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's channel contentB at every event, sitting in the time-symmetric content shared between the channels. The +ic-oriented flow direction is what distinguishes the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel from the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebra; it is the time-asymmetric geometry with no dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel counterpart, because the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebraic apparatus is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation that geometry carries as a primitive feature. The orthodox failure to predict observable physics from these constructions over fifty years is the signature of this confusion: the work has been computing in the algebraic shadow of physical reality and trying to recover physical reality from it, which is impossible because algebra cannot carry the +ic-oriented directional geometry that defines the physical universe.

The historical founding case of the geometry/algebra split at the QM level is the Heisenberg-Schrödinger 1925-1926 case, with three points of the historical record documented at Remark P.3.3.1 of §P.3 below and cross-referenced from Remark IX.30.C.1.3 in the 47-theorem catalog. First, the two derivations proceeded from primarily different empirical starting data — Heisenberg 1925 targeting the frequencies and intensities of atomic emission spectral lines from photographic plates via the Ritz combination principle of Ritz 1908, and Schrödinger 1926a-d targeting de Broglie's matter-wave hypothesis of 1924 as theoretical construct built out via the Hamilton-Jacobi analogy — with convergence at the empirical benchmark of the Bohr hydrogen spectrum. Second, the two physicists came from substantially different mathematical backgrounds — Heisenberg from Bohr-Sommerfeld semi-classical perturbation theory with action-angle variables and Fourier expansion of classical orbits (Connes 2000 [arXiv math/0011193] verbatim: "Heisenberg didn't know about matrices, he just worked it out, but he was told later by Born, Jordan and Dirac that the algebra he had worked out was known to mathematicians as the algebra of matrices"), and Schrödinger from Hamilton-Jacobi mechanics, wave optics, and Sturm-Liouville PDE eigenvalue theory (with mathematician Hermann Weyl at ETH Zurich supplying mathematical collaboration). Third, Schrödinger himself labeled Heisenberg's approach as algebra — verbatim from Schrödinger 1926 via arXiv 0909.3258: "I naturally knew about his [Heisenberg's] theory, but was discouraged by what appeared to me as very difficult methods of transcendental algebra." Hilbert had suggested to Born and Heisenberg months before Schrödinger's paper (per Condon's recollection, arXiv 2511.07502) that they "look for the wave picture behind the algebraic symbols"; Born and Heisenberg dismissed the suggestion. The dual-channel architecture of QM was present at the birth of QM in 1925-1926; the McGucken framework identifies dx₄/dt = ic as the source principle from which both channels descend, extends the split beyond QM to GR and thermodynamics via the 47-theorem catalog of §IX.30.C.1 below, and identifies the content-asymmetry theorem of §IX.30.C.2 (the seventeen mono-channel items the algebraic apparatus cannot reach). The historical Heisenberg-Schrödinger case is prior art for the convergent-overdetermination pattern instantiated at one QM theorem (the Bohr hydrogen spectrum); the McGucken framework identifies the pattern as ubiquitous across foundational physics. Two further pieces of prior-art evidence documented in §P.3.3 below strengthen the historical case. Dirac himself — the physicist who unified matrix mechanics and wave mechanics through transformation theory (Dirac 1927) — explicitly named the two-kinds-of-mathematical-thinking dichotomy (algebraic and geometric) and stated his own preference for the geometric route, in his own written notes for the 30 October 1972 Boston University lecture "Projective Geometry: Origin of Quantum Equations" (Remark P.3.3.2). Verbatim from Dirac's own 1972 notes: "There are basically two kinds of math[ematical] thinking, algebraic and geometric... I prefer the geometric method. Not mentioned in published work because it is not easy to print diagrams... I prefer the relationships which I can visualize in geometric terms." Sir Michael Atiyah (Fields Medal 1966, Abel Prize 2004) stated the algebra-versus-geometry dichotomy as a general fact of mathematical practice in his Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society 34, 1-15 (2002) article "Mathematics in the 20th Century" (Remark P.3.3.3); Atiyah verbatim: "Should you be an algebraist or a geometer? is like saying Would you rather be deaf or blind?" Scope-marking of what the framework's dual-channel claim is not (Bohr complementarity concerns observational aspects of one system rather than derivational routes; Muller 1997 disputes the 1926 equivalence proofs rather than granting them; the 1926-1932 "one theory in two notations" closure is the framework's target rather than its content) appears in Remark P.3.3.4.

## P.2 Mathematically: What the McGucken Duality IS

**Mathematically, the McGucken Duality is a categorical-architectural fact: every theorem of foundational physics admits two disjoint derivations from the single primitive equation dx₄/dt = ic, with the two derivations sharing no intermediate machinery beyond the starting principle and the final theorem. At the level, the architecture is the geometry/algebra distinction of mathematics applied to foundational physics: the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel carries the geometry (the +ic-oriented McGucken Sphere expansion at every event with its directional geometric primitives) and the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel carries the algebra (the operator-algebraic and symmetry-analytic apparatus of Noether, Heisenberg, Born, Jordan, Stone, von Neumann, Wigner, Wightman, and Haag–Kastler with its time-symmetric algebraic structures). The Catalog of Symmetries (the 47-theorem dual catalog) consists of theorems where both halves of mathematics — geometric and algebraic — converge on the same physical statement via disjoint derivations, and the Catalog of Asymmetries (the seventeen mono-channel items of §IX.30.C.2) consists of time-asymmetric directional geometry carried by the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel alone, inaccessible to the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebraic apparatus because algebra is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation that geometry carries as primitive content.**

The algebraic structureM has seven components, with the first being the formal dual-channel architecture itself.

### P.2.0 The dual-channel architecture (§IX.30): formal definition of the geometry/algebra distinction and the constructive-independence theorems

The dual-channel architecture admits a precise formal articulation via Wigner's antiunitary time-reversal operator $T$ on the McGucken-cogenerated Hilbert space $\mathcal H$ (Definition IX.30.1 of §IX.30). The operator $T$ is antilinear ($T(\alpha\psi + \beta\phi) = \alpha^* T\psi + \beta^* T\phi$), antiunitary ($\langle T\psi, T\phi\rangle = \langle\phi, \psi\rangle$), involutive on bosonic states ($T^2 = +1$, with $T^2 = -1$ on fermionic states via the Kramers degeneracy), and acts on the McGucken Sphere by orientation reversal ($T\Sigma_M^+(p) = \Sigma_M^-(p)$), on the imaginary unit by sign reversal ($TiT^{-1} = -i$), and on the principle by sign reversal (sends $dx_4/dt = +ic$ to $dx_4/dt = -ic$). The dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's content is the time-symmetric subalgebra: $\mathcal A = \mathcal B^T = \{X \in \mathcal B : TXT^{-1} = X\}$, i.e., the fixed-point set of the time-reversal action on the framework. The dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's content includes the time-symmetric content (everything in the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel) plus the time-asymmetric directional content (the +ic orientation, the seventeen mono-channel items of §IX.30.C.2). The central distinction is the geometry/algebra distinction of mathematics applied to foundational physics: the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel is geometry, the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is algebra, and the time-reversal action separates the directional geometry (carried only by the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel) from the symmetric algebra (carried by both channels).

The two theorems of the dual-channel architecture, plus the content-asymmetry theorem, are:

- **Theorem IX.30.B.1 (the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's constructive independence).** the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's apparatus — the Hilbert space $\mathcal H$, the operator algebra $B(\mathcal H)$, the canonical commutator $[\hat q, \hat p] = i\hbar$, Stone's theorem on one-parameter unitary groups, the Lorentz group $\mathrm{SO}^+(1,3)$ with metric $\eta_{\mu\nu}$, the Poincaré algebra $\mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$, the McGucken Lagrangian's four-sector form, the Noether conservation currents, the CPT operator, the Wightman axiomatic apparatus, the Haag–Kastler net of local observable algebras — can be developed entirely within algebraic and functional-analytic foundations without ever invoking the McGucken Sphere as derivational input. The proof proceeds by exhibition of the historical-constructive routes (Noether 1918, Heisenberg 1925, Born–Jordan 1925, Dirac 1925, Stone 1932, von Neumann 1932, Wigner 1939, Wightman 1956, Bargmann 1957, Haag–Kastler 1964 each built portions of the apparatus without invoking the Sphere).

- **Theorem IX.30.B.2 (the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's constructive independence).** the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's apparatus — the McGucken manifold $\mathcal M_G$, the source-pair $(\mathcal M_G, D_M)$ co-generated by dx₄/dt = ic, the McGucken Sphere $\Sigma_M^+(p)$ at every event with its +ic orientation, the Huygens-iterated wavefront construction, the Born-rule head-on Sphere-collision derivation, the eight forms of entropy with strict-monotonic +ic orientation, the McGucken-Wick rotation $\tau = x_4/c$, the McGucken Sphere-recruited-fabric mechanism producing the Einstein field equations via Jacobson's 1995 thermodynamic derivation — can be developed entirely from dx₄/dt = ic, without invoking the operator algebra or the Wightman axiomatic apparatus as derivational input.

- **Theorem IX.30.C.3 (Content asymmetry of the dual-channel architecture).** Although the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel and the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel are constructively independent (Theorems IX.30.B.1, IX.30.B.2), the content between them is asymmetric: the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's content contains directional geometry (the +ic orientation, the seventeen mono-channel items of §IX.30.C.2) that dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebraic apparatus cannot reach. The reason: algebra is sign-symmetric on the +ic orientation because algebraic operations preserve the time-symmetry of operator-algebraic structures; geometry has the +ic orientation built in because geometric primitives carry directional content as features. From the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebraic apparatus alone, the +ic orientation cannot be recovered (any function of time-symmetric data is itself time-symmetric; time-symmetric data cannot distinguish +ic from −ic), and the geometric primitive of the McGucken Sphere as a specific point-set in $\mathcal M_G$ cannot be recovered (reconstruction theorems of the Reeh–Schlieder, Gelfand–Naimark, and Connes spectral-triple type each require additional input beyond the algebra). The three theorems together establish that the two channels are constructively independent (each can be developed from its own foundations without invoking the other) but content-asymmetric (the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel carries directional geometry that dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's time-symmetric algebraic apparatus cannot reach). Constructive independence answers "can each channel be built from its own foundations?" — yes, both can. Content asymmetry answers "does one channel's content carry directional content that the other cannot reach?" — yes, the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel's geometric directional content is inaccessible to the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel's algebraic apparatus. The 47-theorem dual catalog of [3] reflects the constructive independence (both constructions reach the same theorem); the mono-channel catalog of §IX.30.C.2 reflects the content asymmetry (the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel has time-asymmetric directional geometry with no dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel image).

### P.2.1 The single principle at the absolute floor of axiomatic complexity

The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic is the single physical principle from which the entirety of mathematical physics is recovered. By the Minimal-Complexity Theorem (Theorem IX.18.7), $C(\mathcal M_G) = 1$ at the absolute floor below which no nontrivial generative system can sit — zero axioms produces nothing; one axiom is the minimum nontrivial complexity. Comparative survey of prior axiomatizations establishes the priority: Hardy's quantum reconstruction requires 5 axioms [Hardy 2001]; Dakić-Brukner 3 [Dakić-Brukner 2009]; Masanes-Müller 5 [Masanes-Müller 2011]; Chiribella-D'Ariano-Perinotti 6 [CDP 2011]; Connes a spectral triple of three independent primitives (algebra, Hilbert space, Dirac operator) [Connes 1994]; Wightman five axioms for QFT; Haag-Kastler the local-net axioms; Atiyah-Segal the TQFT axioms. The McGucken framework operates at $C(\mathcal M_G) = 1$, with the single physical principle dx₄/dt = ic and the entire mathematical apparatus of physics descending as theorems. Hilbert's Sixth Problem (1900) is solved after 126 years through this minimal-complexity articulation (Corollary IX.18.16), with Gödel's 1931 First Incompleteness Theorem not foreclosing the Hilbertian goal because the McGucken formal system $F_M$ does not satisfy the arithmetic-encoding condition G3 (Theorem IX.18.15).

The two derivations share no intermediate machinery beyond the starting principle and the final theorem. The Dual-Channel Disjointness Predicate (Definition IX.26.2) supplies the formal-mathematical criterion by which a pair of derivations is recognized as disjoint, and the Convergent Overdetermination Lemma (Lemma IX.10.4) establishes the disjointness for each theorem.

### P.2.4 The Bayesian-evidentiary force at $\geq 10^{141}$

Two disjoint derivations converging on the same theorem is evidence. Under the null hypothesis that the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic is not the source and the dual-channel agreements are coincidences, the joint probability of 47 independent disjoint-derivation agreements at the conservative benchmark $p_{\text{agree}} = 10^{-3}$ per agreement is approximately $10^{-141}$. Under the dx₄/dt = ic hypothesis, the joint probability is of order unity because the agreements are theorems. The Bayesian likelihood ratio is therefore $\geq 10^{141}$ at conservative benchmarks (Theorem IX.26.11), exceeding conventional thresholds for "decisive" evidence ($10^{2}$) by 139 orders of magnitude. The evidentiary structure is **convergent overdetermination**: multiple disjoint derivations converge on the same theorem, with the convergence too specific to be coincidence. Fit to data is fungible with parameters. Internal consistency is fungible with mathematical richness. overdetermination is fungible with neither.

The McGucken-Wick rotation $\tau = x_4/c$ is a coordinate identification on the real four-manifold $\mathcal M_G$ (§IX.13). The Renou-Trillo-Weilenmann 2021 experiment [Renou-Trillo-Weilenmann 2021] supplies direct empirical corroboration: real-valued quantum mechanics (the formal substitution $i \to 1$) is ruled out at 5σ on standard Bell-type tests, confirming that the $i$ in dx₄/dt = ic is physical. Under the rotation, the dx₄/dt=ic Algebraic Channel is destroyed and the dx₄/dt=ic Geometric Channel is transported (Theorem IX.13.19); the differential response is the formal diagnostic that the two channels are disjoint as derivations.

The McGucken source-pair $(\mathcal M_G, D_M)$ with the six descent functors $F_{\text{spacetime}}: \text{McG} \to \mathrm{LorMfd}$, $F_{\text{Hilbert}}: \text{McG} \to \mathrm{Hilb}$, $F_{\text{Clifford}}: \text{McG} \to \mathrm{Cliff}$, $F_{\text{gauge}}^G: \text{McG} \to \mathrm{PrinBun}_G$, $F_{\text{algebra}}: \text{McG} \to \mathrm{C^*Alg}$, and $F_{\text{Klein}}: \text{McG} \to \mathrm{KleinPair}$ is the initial object in the category $\mathrm{PhysFound}$ of physical-mathematical arenas (Theorem IX.18.13).
